title: Surreal Clock Landscape
description: A large circular clock face with Roman numerals features a three-dimensional surreal landscape on its lower half. A green hilly terrain with a winding path, trees, rocks, a frog, and multiple butterflies emerges from the clock, centered around a tower structure with a smaller clock face at its base.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal clock face with Roman numerals serving as the frame for a three-dimensional miniature landscape. The lower half features rolling green hills with a winding orange path, small trees, rocks, a blue frog, and numerous colorful butterflies in flight. A tall ornate tower with a smaller analog clock at its base rises from the center of the hills, set against the off-white clock face with decorative stars and spheres.
